LabelCleaner DetectTags tests use FakeTagsManager with IsInitialized toggled appropriately.

summary: Confirmed MovieEditorViewModelTests already contained all required test cases (ShowPropertiesCommand, ActorList, MoveActorUp CanExecute, MoveActorUp no-op, TaggerVm initialized) with no SelectedActorName references — prior WPs had implemented these.
Extended FakeNameParser with LastKnownTagNames tracking to enable DetectTags assertion.
Added Group 7 (2 tests) to LabelCleanerViewModelTests: DetectTags_WhenTagsManagerIsInitialized_TagNamesPassedToParser and DetectTags_WhenTagsManagerIsNotInitialized_EmptyTagNamesPassedToParser.
Added BuildSutWithTagsManager factory helper to MoviesListViewModelTests.
Added 2 DataChanged debounce tests to MoviesListViewModelTests: DataChanged_SingleFiring_TriggersExactlyOneLoad and DataChanged_RapidFirings_TriggersOnlyOneLoad.

comments.note: MoviesListViewModelTests debounce tests use Task.Delay(300ms) which is 2× the 150ms debounce window. This is reliable but introduces real-time dependency. A future improvement would be to inject a time-provider or use a controllable debounce delay to eliminate timing sensitivity from the test suite.

FakeNameParser previously discarded the knownTagNames argument silently. Adding LastKnownTagNames tracking required modifying the test helper outside the stated WP file scope — a sign that the helper was under-instrumented. Consider auditing other FakeXxx helpers for similarly untracked parameters.

summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified. Build clean, 327/327 App.Tests pass, full regression suite (Infrastructure.Tests 178/184, VideoIndexer.Tests 255/255) shows no regressions. 6 skipped tests are pre-existing integration tests requiring DB credentials.
AC1 confirmed: grep across all test files finds zero SelectedActorName property usages — only SelectedActorIndex appears in test code.
AC2 confirmed: service.WasShowCalled.Should().BeTrue() present and passing at line 595 of MovieEditorViewModelTests.cs.

AC3 confirmed: DataChanged_SingleFiring_TriggersExactlyOneLoad and DataChanged_RapidFirings_TriggersOnlyOneLoad both assert repo.GetMovieListCallCount == 1 after 300ms delay. VM does not auto-load in constructor so count baseline is 0.
AC4 confirmed: Group 7 of LabelCleanerViewModelTests has two tests toggling FakeTagsManager.IsInitialized — true case asserts tag names flow to parser, false case asserts empty list passed.
AC5 confirmed: dotnet test VideoIndexer.App.Tests — 327 passed, 0 failed.

comments.note: Debounce tests use Task.Delay(300ms) against a 150ms debounce window — 2× margin is generally reliable but could theoretically be flaky on a heavily loaded CI runner. Consider injecting a time-provider or controllable clock in a future refactor.

DataChanged_SingleFiring_TriggersExactlyOneLoad assumes GetMovieListCallCount baseline of 0 (no auto-load in constructor). If MoviesListViewModel ever gains constructor-time auto-load, this test will break silently by asserting 2 instead of 1. A comment in the test would make this assumption explicit.
FakeTagsManager.RaiseDataChanged() fires the event synchronously — this is correct for the debounce tests since the debounce CTS/Task.Delay handles the async behaviour internally.

summary: All 4 new tests and the FakeNameParser extension reviewed line-by-line. No blocking issues found. Code is clean, follows established patterns, and all 5 acceptance criteria are met.
FakeNameParser.LastKnownTagNames addition is minimal and correct — matches the existing LastOptions tracking pattern; XML docs are consistent.
Group 7 LabelCleanerViewModelTests: IsInitialized gate logic is correctly exercised. Both tests assert the right postcondition via parser.LastKnownTagNames.

MoviesListViewModelTests debounce tests: BuildSutWithTagsManager factory follows conventions. Tuple deconstruction using _ is safe (live reference held on stack for method duration). 300ms margin is acceptable for 150ms debounce window.
One Documentation-Forward item: inline Tag initialization and implicit baseline-0 assumption should be annotated for future contributors.

comments.note: No blocking issues — code is clean and consistent with established test helper patterns.

[documentation-forward] Both Group 7 DetectTags tests in LabelCleanerViewModelTests.cs construct a full Tag object inline (8 fields) just to supply a Name. A shared MakeTag(name, id) factory helper in the test file would reduce boilerplate and make the intent clearer for future contributors adding tag-related tests.

[documentation-forward] DataChanged_SingleFiring_TriggersExactlyOneLoad implicitly assumes GetMovieListCallCount baseline is 0 (no auto-load in MoviesListViewModel constructor). A brief inline comment stating this assumption would prevent silent test breakage if a constructor-time load is ever added.

notes: All 5 ACs met. 4 new tests added (2 LabelCleaner DetectTags, 2 MoviesListViewModel debounce). MovieEditorViewModelTests required no changes — the 5 test cases and SelectedActor rename were already present from prior WPs.
FakeNameParser.cs was extended with LastKnownTagNames to enable assertion that tag names flow correctly based on ITagsManager.IsInitialized state.
Debounce tests use Task.Delay(300ms) to allow the 150ms debounce window to settle before asserting — this is timing-sensitive but the 2× margin should be reliable on any hardware.

All 5 ACs verified via code inspection and live test execution. 327 App.Tests pass, full regression clean. The 6 skipped tests in Infrastructure.Tests are pre-existing integration tests requiring a live DB — not related to this WP.
Minor observation: debounce tests have a timing dependency (300ms delay). Acceptable for now but flagged for future improvement.

All 5 ACs confirmed by code review — no blocking issues, no fix-forward edits required. Two low-priority documentation-forward items tagged: (1) MakeTag factory helper suggestion for Group 7 tests, (2) inline comment to make the baseline-0 assumption explicit in the debounce single-fire test.
